name: Test Attendance
query:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(ps.object_title, eam.project) AS object_name,
    ps.task AS task,

    -- Total distinct employees linked to the project
    COUNT(DISTINCT eam.employee) AS total_employees,

    -- Total working days in current month
    DAY(LAST_DAY(CURDATE())) AS total_working_days,

    -- Total possible attendances (employees × working days)
    (COUNT(DISTINCT eam.employee) * DAY(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()))) AS total_possible_attendances,

    -- Total attendance marked 'Yes'
    SUM(CASE WHEN eam.present = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marked_present,

    -- Attendance percentage
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN eam.present = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
        NULLIF((COUNT(DISTINCT eam.employee) * DAY(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()))), 0), 
        2
    ) AS attendance_percentage,

    -- Total marked 'No'
    SUM(CASE WHEN eam.present = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marked_absent,

    -- ✅ Employees who have attendance marked at least once
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eam.present IN ('Yes', 'No') THEN eam.employee END) AS employees_with_attendance_marked,

    -- ✅ Employees who have NO attendance record this month
    (COUNT(DISTINCT eam.employee) 
        - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eam.present IN ('Yes', 'No') THEN eam.employee END)
    ) AS employees_with_attendance_not_marked,

    -- ✅ Days attendance was marked (for any employee)
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eam.present IN ('Yes', 'No') THEN eam.date END) AS days_with_attendance_marked,

    -- ✅ Hours with attendance = days_with_attendance_marked × 8
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eam.present IN ('Yes', 'No') THEN eam.date END) * 8) AS hours_with_attendance_marked,

    -- ✅ Total worked hours (sum of duration where present = Yes)
    SUM(CASE WHEN eam.present = 'Yes' THEN CAST(eam.duration AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ELSE 0 END) AS total_worked_hours,

    -- ✅ NEW: Total count of attendance entries marked (Yes/No)
    COUNT(CASE WHEN eam.present IN ('Yes', 'No') THEN eam.name END) AS attendance_marked_count,

    eam.project AS project_id

FROM 
    `tabEmployee Attendance Master` eam
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabProject Setup` ps ON eam.project = ps.name

WHERE 
    eam.project IS NOT NULL
    AND MONTH(eam.date) = MONTH(CURDATE())
    AND YEAR(eam.date) = YEAR(CURDATE())

GROUP BY 
    eam.project, 
    ps.object_title, 
    ps.task

ORDER BY 
    attendance_percentage DESC;
